summary: Nothing is broken and no hard rule is breached. Three of the four projects closed the week with no open action, and Gnosis carries the only two, both medium refactors found on 2026-10-31. Last week's eight open actions are all closed in code, 16 closures in all across the four status files. The real backlog sits on Kane's hands: the Gnosis release has waited in a ready worktree since early this morning, and the live fog ledger rebuild waits behind it.
